title: Laddu and Chintu's Topsy-Turvy Garland
moral: When we all work together, big jobs become easy and fun.
description: It's Dadaji's birthday, and Laddu and Chintu want to make the biggest, brightest flower garland in Masti Nagar! But flying flowers, sticky glue and a very hungry goat keep getting in the way. Learn simple colour patterns like orange, yellow, orange, yellow in this funny animated teamwork story for kids aged 3 to 8.

narration.text: Whoooosh! Off we zoomed to the flower market! Orange marigolds! Yellow marigolds! Wah!

narration.speaker: pinky
narration.text: A garland needs a pattern! Orange, yellow, orange, yellow!
A pattern is something that repeats, again and again. Orange, yellow, orange, yellow!
But Laddu grabbed one end of the string, and Chintu grabbed the other. Pull! Pull! PULL!
BOING! The flowers flew up high... and landed on Laddu's head like a big orange hat!

narration.speaker: laddu
narration.text: Do I look like a birthday cake?
Under the big banyan tree, Laddu tried first. Orange, orange, orange, orange...

narration.speaker: chintu
narration.text: Laddu! That's all orange! A pattern needs orange, THEN yellow!

narration.speaker: laddu
narration.text: Oops! The orange ones looked like yummy laddoos!

narration.speaker: chintu
narration.text: IDEA! I'll throw you the yellow flowers, and you catch them! A slightly wobbly plan!
One yellow flower... BONK, on Laddu's nose! Two yellow flowers... BONK! Three yellow flowers...
MUNCH! Golu caught them all in his mouth!

narration.speaker: golu
narration.text: Ba-a-a-a!

narration.text: That night, Dadaji was dozing in the courtyard. Snnnnork!
Ready? One, two, three... SURPRISE! Happy birthday, Dadaji!

narration.speaker: dadaji
narration.text: I'm awake! I was just resting my eyes! Ho ho HO!
His big moustache wiggled with joy. Garlands, flags and twinkly diyas, all in happy patterns!

narration.speaker: dadaji
narration.text: Who made all this?

narration.speaker: chintu
narration.text: We all did! Laddu passed, Pinky threaded, I tied, and Golu... tasted a little bit!

narration.speaker: dadaji
narration.text: Thank you, little ones. When we all work together, big jobs become easy and fun! Ho ho HO!
Then Laddu made his very own pattern on a plate. Jalebi, laddoo, jalebi, laddoo!

narration.speaker: laddu
narration.text: Arre wah, jalebi time! Now... munch, munch, munch!
But BOING! Golu got there first! Jalebi, laddoo... GONE!

narration.speaker: golu
narration.text: Ba-a-a-a!
Hee hee! Golu's favourite pattern is... munch, munch, MUNCH!
